scorer.note: Laya (local, free) → Jev TypeSafe (network, paid) → jev-fallback (unknowns). Swap chain order or remove entries as needed.

router.note: Skill routing handled by superpowers (in-context). Keyword-router kept as Layer 2 contract implementation; not called from hooks.

memory.note: Switch to ["openviking","filesystem-fallback"] once OpenViking runs; filesystem-fallback is also appended automatically as last resort.

dev.note: Tried in order; the first orchestrator that supports the mode + input wins. 'nerv' only claims the modes it owns (rebase), so it sits first. Reorder to swap. One-off: --chain a,b or --via x.

afterRebase: If libs/openapi-ts/ specs changed upstream: pnpm nx run openapi-ts:build:types
